title: Pipeline steps
description: The shape of pipeline-steps.json, the one definition of the steps the build pipeline runs for a Task and the deploy pipeline runs for a Story: every kind of step, what it records and reads, which steps its result adds, and the steps planned up front. A step of these pipelines carries its kind as the journal step's script text. orchestrator/core/pipeline_steps.py reads the file for the plugin and the driver; scripts/shared-blocks.mjs copies it into the step-journal shared block every workflow script of these pipelines carries.

pipelines.description: The pipelines, by the pipeline name of the step journal schema.

text.description: A string that is not empty.

kindKey.description: The key of a step kind: the pipeline name, a colon, and a kebab-case name.

runner.description: What runs the steps of a kind: the driver, or the workflow script of that name.

artifactKind.description: The kind of an artifact, as the step journal schema names it.

recorded.description: One artifact a step of the kind records.

name.description: The artifact's name in the journal.

holds.description: What the path names, or the shape of the value.

addition.description: Steps the result of a step of the kind adds to the journal.

kinds.description: The kinds added, in the order the steps run.

when.description: The result that calls for them.

description.description: What a step of the kind does, in plain words. A name in braces is replaced by the parameter of that name the step is handed.

purpose.description: Why a step of the kind exists. The step that adds one may state the finding that caused it instead.

within.description: The kind of the step this kind's steps are child steps of. Absent for a step among the bead's outermost steps.

params.description: The names of the parameters the step that adds a step of this kind hands it.

reads.description: The names of the artifacts of earlier steps a step of the kind is handed.

records.description: The artifacts a step of the kind records when it is done.

adds.description: The steps the result of a step of the kind can add.

together.description: True when consecutive planned steps of the kind run at the same time.

waits.description: What a step of the kind stays running for, and is asked again about on each dispatch. Absent for a step that does not wait.

limit.description: The rule by which a step of the kind declines to add another correction and fails with the cause instead.

pipeline.description: One pipeline: the steps planned up front, the child steps planned when a step first runs, and every kind.

plan.description: The kinds planned up front, in the order the steps run, after the step that created the bead.

inner.description: By the kind of a step a workflow script performs: the kinds of the child steps the script plans under it when it first runs, in the order they run.

kinds.description: Every kind of step of the pipeline, by key.
